Get ready, folks. Tomorrow, that rocket behind me is launching four astronauts to the Moon for the first time in more than 50 years.

The federal government doesn’t get to tell Arizona how to run its elections. 

Vote by mail in Arizona is secure. Voters from every corner of the state and every political viewpoint have used it for decades to elect Republicans and Democrats. 

I’ll support @AGKrisMayes and @AZSecretary with anything they need to fight this and protect Arizona voters.


ABC News (@ABC)

President Trump signs an executive order aimed at cracking down on mail-in voting. abcnews.link/u7FCfmX

I asked DHS last year about this and never got a response. Now I know why.   
  
ICE was arresting people at their own immigration court hearings for no justifiable reason. The “regrettable error” is this rogue agency’s tactics that have needlessly torn families apart. We need answers. We need accountability.

Great piece on the Artemis II crew. I know these four. They're the right people for this mission. 
 
And for the record, if Reid needs a backup, I'm available.

Today on Trans Day of Visibility, we celebrate the trans community and honor their resilience and courage.  
   
Transgender Americans deserve to live freely and safely. That hasn't changed, and neither has our commitment to fighting for it.

Health care should be affordable and accessible for every family. But Trump and Republicans slashed Medicaid and allowed health care premiums to skyrocket — all to pay for tax cuts for rich people. We should be lowering costs and expanding coverage, not making it harder for people to get care.

It’s happening. We’re going back to the Moon. 🌔

Video

The cost of living is sky high. Let’s call it what it is: an emergency. But Washington isn’t treating it like one.

That’s why @RepDeluzio and I are introducing legislation to force action and put working Americans first.

Video

Today, we honor the Americans who served in Vietnam and recognize the courage and sacrifice that service demanded. Brave men and women from across the country served with courage, and many gave their lives. We can never repay them for their sacrifice.

The Senate unanimously passed a deal to end the shutdown and get paychecks to workers who’ve been working without pay for over a month. And now Republicans in the House failed to pass the bipartisan deal. 

Here’s why this is so important 🧵

Those are just a few examples. Across DHS, 100,000 people have been working without pay. The Senate bill funded all of this without funding ICE so that we can keep working to overhaul the agency and make sure we have transparency and accountability.
There’s a real cost to a shutdown, and that’s why we’ve been working hard to end it and passed this bill Thursday night. It’s time for House Republicans and Donald Trump to do the same.

Everything costs too much—and Washington is focused on the wrong things.

While the stock market gets attention, families are getting squeezed.

That’s why @RepDeluzio and I are introducing a bill to refocus your government on what matters most: lowering your costs.

Video

Last week, Arizona hit triple digits — the earliest date we’ve ever had a 100° day. Families are going to be cranking up the A/C already and feeling it in their power bills. That’s why I’m pushing a new law to fix the outdated formula used to distribute utility assistance so Arizona families can stay safe in this heat.

Americans have had enough of Big Tech companies putting profits before people, and this verdict proves it. @SenJohnCurtis and I will keep pushing to pass our Algorithm Accountability Act to make sure they can be held responsible when their platforms hurt people.


Kyle Griffin (@kylegriffin1)
